name: utm-governance
description: Create a UTM naming convention and check my campaign links against our register, returning a naming sheet, flagged links, proposed corrected URLs and an exception register while preserving historical campaign identities. Use when I ask to settle campaign names, standardize agency tags or check newsletter links from pasted text and readable exports. Separate approved vocabulary from future proposals, preserve click IDs and anchors, and flag ambiguous aliases, duplicate fields and identity conflicts. Not for live analytics access, redirect testing, campaign performance reporting or account changes.
